title_en: GTA 6 is Now The Joint-Highest Rated Game of All Time
summary_en: GTA 6 has become the joint-highest rated game of all time, following the widespread publication of reviews.
body_en:
GTA 6 has become the joint-highest rated game of all time, following the widespread publication of reviews in the past hour.
Rockstar's masterpiece currently sits with an all-time best score of 99 on Metacritic , an honor shared only with Nintendo's original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time release back in 1997 on N64, almost 30 years ago. No other game since has managed such a feat. (The new version of Ocarina for Switch 2 managed a paltry score of just 96.)
While both the N64 version of Ocarina and GTA 6 share a 99 average, GTA 6 has impressively managed to pull this off with more than six times' the number of reviews — over 120 at the time of writing, with over 100 of those listed with a perfect score. And while it's possible GTA 6's ranking could still slip down a point as more reviews are published, it would still be the best-rated game in nearly three decades.
Few others titles released in the recent memory have come anywhere close to this — though if you head back to the last console generation, Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Super Mario Odyssey both managed a 97 average, a standing they share with Rockstar's own Red Dead Redemption 2.
IGN's GTA 6 review is of course now live, and also returned a perfect 10/10 score. We described it as "exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered," as well as "unprecedented, unbelievable and unmissable."
IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours.
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social
